units.source_text: 很快，长老的解说就让我觉得厌烦了。

en.t: Before long, the elder's explanation began to bore me.

units.source_text: 因为他特别加上的说明，我听着却像是陈旧的比喻。

en.t: Because of the extra explanation he had deliberately added, it sounded to me like a worn-out metaphor.

units.source_text: 我一面假装认真地听着，一面自己偷偷观察大寺院内部。

en.t: While pretending to listen attentively, I was secretly observing the inside of the great temple for myself.
